fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Version of this sidecar row; constant 1.

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: Non-whitespace run identity; preserve accepted string exactly.

fields.name: causal_event_id
fields.description: u64 event index LE followed by u32 generation LE.

fields.name: transition_ordinal
fields.description: Zero-based contiguous committed-transition ordinal within causal event.

fields.name: time_ticks
fields.description: LifecycleRecord.at as u128 little-endian ticks.

fields.name: time_scale
fields.description: Constant ticks.

fields.name: resource_id
fields.description: u64 entity index LE followed by u32 generation LE.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: u64 entity index LE followed by u32 generation LE.

fields.name: owner_id
fields.description: u64 entity index LE followed by u32 generation LE.

fields.name: work_id
fields.description: Optional WorkId encoded as generational entity ID.

fields.name: lease_revision
fields.description: Revision of resulting LifecycleRecord.lease; null when no resulting lease.

fields.name: causal_lease_revision
fields.description: Revision of LifecycleSnapshot.causal_lease; its request must equal request_id.

fields.name: transition
fields.description: LifecycleTransition snake_case token.

fields.name: request_state
fields.description: RequestState snake_case token.

fields.name: strategy
fields.description: Optional configured PreemptionStrategy: suspend, abort, restart.

fields.name: preemptor_request_id
fields.description: Optional direct eviction preemptor; applicable only to Preempted/Aborted eviction rows.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Snapshot request priority level.

fields.name: queue_len
fields.description: Checked post-mutation queue length from staged ResourceStage.

fields.name: active_count
fields.description: Checked post-mutation active allocation count from staged ResourceStage.

fields.name: capacity
fields.description: Capacity from staged ResourceStage.

fields.name: original_duration_ticks
fields.description: Optional WorkProgress.original_duration as u128 LE.

fields.name: useful_elapsed_ticks
fields.description: Optional WorkProgress.useful_elapsed as u128 LE.

fields.name: remaining_ticks
fields.description: Optional WorkProgress.remaining as u128 LE; zero is a value, not null.

fields.name: cumulative_busy_ticks
fields.description: Optional WorkProgress.cumulative_busy as u128 LE.

fields.name: attempt_revision
fields.description: Optional WorkProgress.attempt_revision.

fields.name: execution_revision
fields.description: Optional WorkProgress.execution_revision.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Always null in v1; never infer a reason from state or transition.
